questions.question: The first President of the All India Trade Union Congress was ____.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Lala Lajpat Rai . According to provisional statistics from the Ministry of Labour,  AITUC had a membership of 14.2 million in 2013.  It was founded on  31 October 1920 with Lala Lajpat Rai as its first president. questions.question: At which of the following places was the formal proclamation of the Swadeshi movement made on 7 August 1905?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Calcutta Town Hall . Key Points Swadeshi Movement : The Swadeshi Movement was proclaimed on August 7, 1905, at the Calcutta Town Hall, in Bengal.  When Lord Curzon, then Viceroy of India, announced the partition of Bengal in July  1905 , Indian National Congress, initiated the Swadeshi movement in Bengal.  The Swadeshi movement was launched as a protest movement which also gave a lead to the Boycott movement in the country. questions.question: In which of the following years was the Aligarh movement started by Syed Ahmed Khan?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  1875. Key Points Sir Syed  launched the Aligarh Movement of which  Aligarh was the centre . He had two immediate objectives in mind: to remove the state of misunderstanding and tension between the Muslims and the new British government and to induce them to go after the opportunities available under the new regime without deviating in any way from the fundamentals of their faith. questions.question: Which of the following was a system of indigo cultivation in British India?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Nij . Key Points Nij  was a system of indigo cultivation in British India. There were two main systems of indigo cultivation – nij and ryoti. Within the system of nij cultivation , the planter produced indigo in lands that he directly controlled. He either bought the land or rented it from other zamindars and produced indigo by directly employing hired labourers. questions.question: Who among the following freedom fighters was accused of killing Michael o Dwyer?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Udham Singh. Key Points Udham Singh, a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement, was accused of killing Sir Michael O'Dwyer, a former Lieutenant Governor of the Punjab province during British rule in India. The incident took place in the aftermath of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre, a tragic event where British troops under General Reginald Dyer opened fire on a peaceful gathering in Amritsar on April 13, 1919. The eldest son of Debendranath Tagore  was Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941).
